_readme: Canonical macros for recurring foods. Consulted by the /log-day skill BEFORE estimating. When the user corrects a macro estimate, update the matching entry here (or add a new one) so the correction sticks. Prefer per-component entries over whole-meal composites. All macros are per stated serving.

foods.name: Cavendish banana
foods.notes: Settled value used consistently since late April.

foods.name: Meiji High Protein Milk — 30g flavored (banana/chocolate/matcha)
foods.notes: Flavored variants (Banana/Chocolate/Matcha) — labels: banana 176 kcal/9g C, chocolate 179/9.8g C, matcha ~165/lower C. User rounds all to 180 kcal. Whey-based, no added sucrose. Source: CP-Meiji SG label + FatSecret SG.

foods.name: Meiji High Protein Milk — 32g plain (unflavored)
foods.notes: Plain unflavored variant. Source: MyNetDiary + CP-Meiji SG label.

foods.name: Psyllium husk
foods.notes: Scale linearly for other quantities.

foods.name: Hainanese Chicken Rice (standard)
foods.serving: 270g rice + 120g skin-on boneless breast + 25g cucumber + chilli + soup
foods.notes: History of corrections (Apr 27) before settling. Variants: 15g chilli paste only = 726 / 44.1 / 108 / 12.1 / 3.7; 310g cooked skin-on BI drumstick instead of breast = 966 / 43.9 / 108 / 33.3 / 3.7. Excludes banana.

foods.name: Kung Pao chicken rice bowl + 1 fried egg
aliases: kp chicken rice bowl + fried egg
foods.notes: Portion varies by stall day (logged 670-790). Use 670 as base; '75% rice reduced' variant + banana = 685 / 34.3 / 78.5 / 25.4 / 5.1.

foods.name: BI skinless chicken drumstick + 18g tandoori paste
foods.notes: Derived from the settled '300g drumstick + tandoori + 4 boiled eggs + 10g psyllium = 635' composite minus 4 boiled eggs (~310 / 25 / 2 / 21 / 0) and psyllium. Scale by raw weight.

foods.name: Boiled egg
foods.notes: Standard value consistent with logged composites.

foods.name: Stuff'd Chicken Burrito (loaded)
foods.serving: 1 burrito: cheese, iceberg, tomato salsa, habanero, adobo black beans, butter corn

foods.name: Pumpkin seeds, raw hulled kernels (pepitas)
foods.notes: Akshar 200g pack. IGNORE the printed panel (19.4g fat / 53.7g carb / 18.5g protein per 100g) - those are not pumpkin kernel values; photo confirms hulled green pepitas. USDA hulled kernel basis used: 559 kcal / 49g fat / 30g protein / 11g carb / 6g fiber per 100g. Per 25g also gives Mg 138mg, Zn 1.95mg, Fe 2.2mg, K 202mg. Useful dose 25-30g; 5g is negligible. Raw is fine - do not roast (degrades vitamin E, oxidises PUFA); soak overnight if reducing phytates.

foods.name: Cookies & Cream cheesecake (70g slice)
foods.notes: From pack label: 236.6 kcal per 70g serving. Usually eaten 1-2 slices. NOT the same product as the plain cheesecake label (313.6 kcal/100g, 27.6g fat, 12.4g carb) logged 2026-08-17.

foods.name: Banana pudding
foods.notes: Estimated; no label seen yet.

foods.name: Thai pink guava
foods.notes: Scale linearly by weight. Per 100g also ~100mg vitamin C, ~415mg potassium, ~22mg magnesium, lycopene (pink flesh). Single best micronutrient item in the rotation.

foods.name: Chia seeds (soaked)
foods.notes: User's pack states 48g fibre/100g (higher than USDA 34g) - label used. Per 20g also ~3.5g ALA omega-3, 126mg calcium, 67mg magnesium, 1.5mg iron. ALA only: converts to EPA ~5%, DHA <1% - NOT a fish-oil substitute.

foods.name: Omega-3 egg (boiled)
foods.notes: From pack label per serving: 25.5ug selenium, 0.1g DHA+EPA, 0.2g total omega-3, 214mg cholesterol, 78.1mg sodium. 3 eggs = ~300mg EPA+DHA, which meets the 250-500mg daily target WITHOUT fish. Distinct from the plain Boiled egg template.

foods.name: Myprotein Essential Whey
foods.notes: Per 100g: 425 kcal, 65g protein, 16g fat (9.4g sat), 3.4g carb. Budget concentrate line - 65% protein by weight vs ~80% for Impact Whey. 6.6 kcal per gram of protein; Impact Whey is ~4.9. Fine, but less protein per calorie.

foods.name: Meiji multi-vitamin milk
foods.notes: Lactose-hydrolysed. Per 200ml: Ca 400mg, vit E 5.2mg, zinc 4.0mg, iron 3.0mg, vit A 236ug, folate 94.8ug, selenium 22.8ug, vit K 21.4ug, vit D3 2.4ug, B12 1.4ug, niacin 4.6mg, B6 1.4mg, B1/B2 0.8mg, biotin 56.6ug, phosphorus 228.4mg, sodium 100mg. Far better micro profile than the previous high-calcium milk, which supplied only calcium and D3.

foods.name: Indomie (1 pack, prepared)
foods.notes: Label figure. Nearly all sodium is in the seasoning sachet (~950mg); the noodle block alone is ~250mg. Half-sachet halves the sodium at no calorie cost.

foods.name: Chicken McCrispy 2pc (spicy or original)
foods.notes: McDonald's SG label. Spicy and original are identical on the label. Verified 2026-08-05 via fatsecret.com.sg after the McD SG site returned placeholder zeros.

foods.name: Korean BBQ chicken hotplate (full plate)
foods.serving: full plate: ~240g chicken + 200g rice + veg + kimchi
foods.notes: University Korean stall. 3/4 plate variant = 595 / 35 / 75 / 15 / 2.5 (logged 2026-07-19). Sodium-heavy from marinade plus kimchi.

foods.name: iJooz fresh orange juice
foods.notes: ~70mg vitamin C per glass. On both Jul 20 and Aug 6 it single-handedly lifted the day from ~12mg to ~72-75mg vitamin C.

foods.name: Palak paneer rice set
foods.notes: Estimated. Spinach gravy makes this the highest vitamin K meal in the rotation (~480ug from ~100g spinach). Lower sodium than the chicken rice and Korean stall options.
